fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer did not declare a second-quarter dividend despite a strong half-year result, citing an uncertain global and geopolitical environment, but said its annual dividend policy is unchanged.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer's first-quarter EPS was about PKR 2, and earnings rose sharply in the second quarter.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst reads the skipped payout as caution on the global outlook, which disappointed shareholders and put selling pressure on the share price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst argues Fatima had no bank loans left and enough cash to pay the dividend, and notes that Fauji Fertilizer and Engro paid dividends even in tougher conditions.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Fatima's books hold other investments, including stakes in Fatima Cement and Pak Fertilizer, which the analyst says should have supported a dividend.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Globe Residency REIT reported a large dividend roughly equal to its EPS, yet its shares still saw selling pressure and did not rally as the analyst had expected.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst expects a new REIT in the pipeline to lift sentiment, as Globe Residency's projects are complete and it has been a mature operation since 2021.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Sunehri Bank did not pay the half-year dividend investors had expected, and the share price fell further.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst notes Sunehri Bank traded at a very low earnings multiple, around 4 to 5 times P/E, yet the missing dividend kept the stock weak.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst sees mid-tier and smaller banks facing higher deposit costs that squeeze earnings; EPS was flat quarter on quarter and small dividends did not produce a share rally.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: At midday on 21 Aug 2026 the market showed mildly bearish sentiment, and the analyst expected a rebound from a support level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst describes a sector rotation from refining into oil marketing and upstream oil and gas, with OGDC and PPL seen as dividend candidates.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The government could draw large dividends from its OGDC and PPL holdings; the analyst cites about PKR 540 billion being discussed, but calls it only speculation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst sees OGDC's oil output numbers improving in several fields, including some run jointly with PPL, which supports the sector rotation view.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Gas-sector receivables owed to OGDC and PPL by SNGPL and SSGC remain high and unresolved.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Pakistan's cement industry has installed capacity of about 84 million tonnes, while dispatches of about 50 million tonnes leave utilisation well below full.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Cement industry dispatches were about 50 million tonnes in 2025, down from about 55 million tonnes in 2021.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst expects cement dispatches could recover to the 2021 level of about 55 million tonnes in FY27 if budget-led spending holds up.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Budget-linked infrastructure work such as roads and highways could lift cement and flat steel demand, which the analyst sees as the main swing factor for utilisation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement has a long-standing pattern of Q4 earnings beating street consensus, and the analyst expects a similar result for Q4 2026.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's export sales rose in 2026 and its local prices per tonne and per 50kg bag kept rising, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: A large DG Khan Cement stake is reported to have moved into Mansha group companies, which the analyst sees as raising the company's strategic weight.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst says DG Khan Cement fell behind Lucky Cement, Best Cement and Maple Leaf after 2017-18, when its dollar-linked coverage did not keep pace with the exchange rate.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Pakistan's flat steel sector performed better in 2026 than in the previous four to five years, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: Flat steel demand is supported by motorcycle and car sales and by house construction such as doors and frames in Punjab, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: International Steels reported EPS of about PKR 8, and the analyst calls its results strong.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)

fact_text: International Industries, a holding company with a majority stake in International Steels and about 20% of Pakistan Cables, reported better standalone EPS.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'ISL & DGKC progress | Sector Rotation Strategy | FATIMA Skips Dividend | Midday Flash 21 Aug 2026' (YouTube, 2026-08-21)
